original_jp: ええ…

original_en:
That is not the Dragon Orb. It is a
sealstone formed by a geological anomaly.

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: …何だよ そりゃ？

speaker: Lezard
original_jp: 精気の〓です

original_en:

normally impalpable and invisible
to human senses.
original_jp: 本来 常人には見る事も〓る事もできないはずの非物〓ですが <PART> ――

original_en:
It resonates with my spiritual energy,
causing it to radiate visible light.
original_jp: おそらく私の精神に呼応して目視が可能な光を放っているんでしょう

speaker: Silmeria
original_en:
Photons convert energy absorbed from
the roots of the world tree, Yggdrasil,
to light.
original_jp: 大地を支える〓グドラシルの根から放たれる力を〓収し 光に変えたのが光子

speaker: Silmeria
original_en:
Sealstones are residue formed from
the hardened "sap" that drips from
Yggdrasil's roots.
original_jp: 封印石は〓グドラシルの根から〓れ出て〓まった いわば〓のようなものね

speaker: Rufus
original_en: You mean like amber from Yggdrasil...
original_jp: 〓グドラシルのカスって事か…

speaker: Lezard
original_en:
Call it amber if you will. A sealstone
exerts power over the area it is placed.
original_jp: カスとはいえ封印石は安置された場に力を与えます

speaker: Lezard
original_en:
It suppresses the actions of enemies
bound to this location and the
surrounding areas.
original_jp: この場所と 周〓一〓に縁のある敵の動きを〓えてくれるでしょう

speaker: Rufus
original_en:
Then, how about if we take it with us
for protection?
original_jp: じゃあ持って歩けばお守りになるのか？

speaker: Lezard
original_en:
Sealstones don't just affect enemies.
The bearer may also be subject to some change.
original_jp: 〓えられるのは敵ばかりではありません持つ者も何らかの影〓を受けるでしょう

speaker: Lezard
original_en:
If you were to carry it, Sir Rufus, then
the effects would be felt by all of us.
original_jp: 仮にルーファス殿が持つのなら行動を共にする我々にも です

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: …どんな影〓だよ？

speaker: Lezard
original_en:
I'm afraid that's just it...
One cannot know until one tries.
original_jp: さあ そればかりは…やってみなければわかりません

speaker: Dylan
original_en:
The tribe that guarded the Dragon Orb had
to be very familiar with these sealstones.
original_jp: ドラゴンオーブを守護する一族はこの封印石の力を熟知していたはずだ

speaker: Rufus
original_en:
So, they used that knowledge in building
palaces to keep the Dragon Orb safe...
original_jp: その知恵でもって ドラゴンオーブを安置する神殿を〓てたってのか…

speaker: Rufus
original_en:
Sounds like it wouldn't hurt to take it
with us.
original_jp: やっぱり持ってって損はなさそうだな

speaker: Silmeria
original_en:
Sealstones cannot be disposed of, nor
can they be held onto forever.
original_jp: 途中で捨てる事もできなければ永遠に持ち続ける事も不可能 <PART> ――

speaker: Silmeria
original_en:
At some point, their world-sustaining
power will crush the holder.
original_jp: いずれ大地を支える力に〓し潰される事になるでしょうね

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: …ええ

speaker: Rufus
original_en: Real funny... Thanks a lot, Silmeria.
original_jp: なんだよ… シルメリアも意地悪だな

original_en:
During the process of transferring from
a dais to another dais, the carrier acts
as a base.
original_jp: 〓り所となる〓〓から〓〓へ〓す間は運ぶ者がその〓〓代わりになる

speaker: Silmeria
original_jp: 封印石は絶えず〓り所を必要とする

Alright, so I can't handle it. You could
